blocks.content: You've learned arrays–how to create, access, and manipulate them using methods like map(), filter(), and reduce(). You also built a project to apply these skills in real-world scenarios.
If anything feels unclear, review and practice for a stronger understanding.
Next, you'll explore objects, which help you organize data into meaningful structures. Let's get started!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
